svg.title: A branching tree. The root x1 has children x1, x1, x2. The first x1 has children x1, x1, x2, which end in the leaves 3, 4 and +; the second x1 ends in the leaf 2 and x2 ends in the leaf star. Labels on the right give the counts of x1 and x2 nodes in each generation: Z0 = [1,0], Z1 = [2,1], Z2 = [2,1], Z3 = [0,0].
